node_id_note: No save.pkl exists for Run 5. AutoRecLab writes the tree-search state to the fixed path ./out/save.pkl (treesearch/search.py:126-129), and that file was overwritten by Run 7 on 2026-07-16. The node is therefore identified by tree-search iteration, reviewer score, its position in the log, and the SHA-256 of its code.
selection_reason: Only node in Run 5 whose execution succeeded; all 3 draft nodes and iterations 1-8 and 10 were flagged buggy. AutoRecLab fell back to 'Found no satisfactory node; Using best node instead' (run_stdout.log:609).
code_sha256_note: Computed on the file with CRLF normalised to LF and surrounding whitespace stripped. Identical to the SHA-256 of the 'code' field of the return_plan_and_code tool call embedded at run_stdout.log:556, which proves this file is the code that produced the reported numbers.

misconfiguration.affected: ItemKNN on all three datasets (3 of 9 sub-experiments)
misconfiguration.cause: LensKit 0.14.4 ItemItem defaults to feedback='explicit', which sets aggregate='weighted-average' and use_ratings=True. The node overrides only center. Because the training frame carries no rating column, all interactions enter as unary 1.0, so the weighted average sum(1*sim)/sum(|sim|) evaluates to exactly 1.0 for every scorable item.
misconfiguration.observed_effect: Every recommendation receives the identical score 1.0; the ranking is pure tie-breaking and carries no similarity signal.
